savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Each advisory committee listed below is continued until December 31, 1982.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Continues sixteen named advisory committees. Neither EO 12078 (World Hunger Commission) nor EO 12103 (Coal Industry Commission) is on the list; it saves nothing of the two batch orders.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 1-105: 'This Order shall be effective December 31, 1980.' The revocations in sec. 1-103 are therefore effective 1980-12-31 (printed 46 FR 1251-1252, January 6, 1981).

targets_in_batch_03.EO:12078: sec. 1-103(e) ('Executive Order No. 12078, as amended, establishing the President's Commission on World Hunger')
targets_in_batch_03.EO:12103: sec. 1-103(g) ('Executive Order No. 12103, as amended, establishing the President's Commission on the Coal Industry')

conclusion: EO 12258 (signed 1980-12-31, 46 FR 1251, PDF pages 13-14, read once in full) continues sixteen advisory committees to 1982-12-31 (sec. 1-101), assigns the President's FACA functions (1-102), revokes ten orders 'that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed' (1-103), supersedes EO 12110 (1-104) and takes effect 1980-12-31 (1-105). The revocation recital itself says the two batch committees had already terminated or finished, so sec. 1-103 is a clean-up and not the first end of their clauses. There is no savings, transfer or exception provision for the revoked committees.
